messages:
felix: Heads-up: scheduling a regional cold-cache failover drill (us-west) next Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Goal: exercise cold-model startup, KV cache rehydration, and our SLO-tiered fallback logic under realistic drain conditions. TL;DR: staged AZ drains + synthetic load + fallback -> rollback gates.

nora: Scope? Customer impact expected?

felix: Scope: only us-west region, canary AZ->full-region failover sequence. We will not change live tenant weights; instead we'll trigger a controlled drain and mark requests for the drill via header x-sre-drill: coldfail. Synthetic traffic only for the main test window. Minimal customer impact expected if runbook gates are followed.

yuki: Preflight checklist? Observability owners?

felix: Preflight (01:30-02:00): prewarm KV prefixes, pin model variants for cold startup, bump reserved pool min by +30%, set trace sampling to 100% for drill tags. Canary (02:00-02:20): drain AZ-b, shift 10% traffic via failover rule to other AZs; Ramp (02:20-02:50): escalate to 50%; Full drain (02:50-03:20): region failover; Soak + rollback window (03:20-04:00). Owners: yuki observability, nora proxy+routing, felix ops/runbook, support-lead customer comms.

nora: Routing snippet (will push under flag 'coldfail-v1'):
```
route 'coldfail-staging' {
  match: header(x-sre-drill) == 'coldfail'
  preference: [
    { pool: 'us-west-az-a', weight: 0.9 },
    { pool: 'us-west-az-b', weight: 0.1 }
  ]
  failover_policy: 'graceful-evict'
}
```
Will roll to 2 canary proxies first.

infra-bot: Maintenance scheduled: regional-cold-cache-failover-drill by felix on 2930012345 (Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC). Notified groups: eng-sre, eng-runtime, product, support.

yuki: Observability checklist: - create metric namespace 'coldfail.dryrun' - synthetic probes from us-east/us-west/eu-central - p95/p99 baselines for impacted routes - enable 100% traces for drill headers for first 40m - dashboards: kv-rewarm-time, cold-start-latency, reserved-pool-cpu. Alerts: soft warn p99>260ms for 3m, hard p99>320ms for 5m OR error rate>0.6% 5m.

felix: Rollback gates: soft trigger -> pause ramp and engage fallback (70% reserved, 30% shared for drill-tagged traffic). Hard trigger -> immediate revert flags + revert autoscaler overrides. Full conditions spelled out in runbook: https://intranet.redwood/sre/runbooks/cold-cache-failover-drill.

slo-bot: SLO note: drifts to SLOs will be scoped to .dryrun metrics. No permanent SLO change will be applied. Draft fallback SLO thresholds: p99 target for enterprise-route remain 180ms; drill scoped alerts apply to .dryrun only.

felix: Loadtest commands (run from loadtest cluster):
```
# global synthetic at 02:05
./tools/loadtest --route coldfail --duration 20m --qps 700 --header 'x-sre-drill: coldfail' --tag coldfail-global-2024
# regional spike at 02:40
./tools/loadtest --route coldfail --duration 15m --qps 1200 --region us-west --header 'x-sre-drill: coldfail' --tag coldfail-uswest-spike
```
Teams can run additional regionals but must use the header.

nora: Autoscaler note: reserved pool min +30% at 01:10. I'll set autoscaler.hold=true during the canary window to avoid noisy scale churn. PR will be posted.

support-lead: Support will publish brief status templates and standby a senior rep during the window. If we flip fallback, we'll use this canned message: 'We're performing a scheduled resilience drill in your region; you may see brief latency increases. We're monitoring and will post updates.'

yuki: Metric isolation: append '.coldfail' suffix to test metrics to avoid noisy alerts. Also add burn-rate suppression rule for the drill window.

felix: Good idea on partial fallback policy: soft trigger -> set 'coldfail-fallback' config: 70% reserved, 30% shared; log all fallback events to dedicated audit stream. Only escalate to full rollback on hard trigger.

nora: PR: https://intranet.redwood/ops/changes/PR-5120 (coldfail routing + autoscaler hold). Will link deploy steps here once merged.

infra-bot: Reminder 45m: regional-cold-cache-failover-drill starts in 45 minutes.

yuki: I'll be on-call for observability from 01:50-04:10 UTC. @nora please own routing flips; @felix you'll own rollback and postmortem. Keep in-thread updates short (start/ok/problem/rollback/done).

felix: Ack. Please react to confirm. :white_check_mark:

nora: ack :thumbsup:

yuki: ack :white_check_mark:

support-lead: ack
